This repository packages a BraTS-style U-Net into a Streamlit application for Hugging Face Spaces. The runtime path is intentionally CPU-only, so the app can boot quickly in a small container and avoid GPU-specific serialization issues.

The deployment loader searches model/unet.weights.h5 first, then falls back to model/unet.hdf5, model/unet.keras, and model/unet.h5 if present. For the cleanest Hugging Face deployment, keep unet.weights.h5 in model/ and treat unet.hdf5 as a compatibility artifact only.
